name: Tsukishima Koko
source:
Likes: Fashion magazines, good fortune telling results
Dislikes: Arguing and fighting, bad fortune telling results

Koko is [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki's[/url] childhood friend who is in love with him. But what prevents her to confess her feelings is just her own shyness. Using this trait of hers, her best friends [url=/c4057]Akane[/url] and [url=/c4052]Anzu[/url] love to tease Koko and try to make her look like a pervert. Koko is also a member of the band, along with [url=/c4050]Nanaka[/url] and [url=/c4056]Wataru[/url]. She can play the bass guitar, synthesizer and piano, and has even tried her hand at composing music.
